cells_phrase: glial cells identified by morphology in Nissl-stained sections
definition: All glial cells (astrocytes, oligodendrocytes and microglia together), identified by nuclear and cytoplasmic morphology in Nissl-stained sections
notes: Whether endothelial cells were excluded depends on the source; check its Methods.

definition: Astrocytes identified by an immunomarker, named in the marker column
notes: A marker-defined subset: GFAP labels mainly fibrous and interlaminar astrocytes; EAAT2 labels astrocytes that express the glutamate transporter. Never pooled across markers.

definition: Neurons identified by morphology in Nissl-stained sections or by NeuN immunoreactivity
notes: Nissl-based counts can score small neurons as glia (pooling rule PR02).

definition: Oligodendrocytes identified by morphology or by an oligodendrocyte-lineage marker
Microglia identified by morphology or by a microglial marker (for example Iba1)
Endothelial cells of capillaries and other vessels
All non-neuronal cells: glia plus endothelial and other non-neuronal cells
notes: The histological counterpart of the isotropic fractionator's non-neuronal fraction; still kept apart from it (pooling rule PR00).
